# FixHive Garage

> FixHive Garage (Saher Auto General Repairing LLC) is an independent, premium automotive repair workshop in Dubai Investment Park (DIP 1), Dubai, UAE, offering dealer-level diagnostics and repair for 45+ car brands — from mainstream Japanese and Korean makes to European luxury and exotic marques (Ferrari, Lamborghini, Rolls-Royce, Bentley, Aston Martin, Maserati) — at independent-garage prices.

Address: WH2 FixHive, 80 Street, Dubai Investment Park First, Dubai, UAE (24.972111, 55.1737988).
Hours: Monday–Saturday, 08:30–19:00. Closed Sundays.
Contact: +971 54 169 9500 (phone & WhatsApp) · sale.ae@myfixhive.ae
Warranty: 12 months / 10,000 km on parts and labor. Diagnostic platforms include VCDS, ISTA, and PIWIS for dealer-grade fault reading and programming. 4.9-star Google rating, 18+ years serving Dubai.
An Arabic version of most pages is available under the same path prefixed with /ar/ (e.g. /ar/services.html).

## Services

- [All Services](https://myfixhive.ae/services.html): Overview of every repair and maintenance service offered.
- [Engine Repair](https://myfixhive.ae/engine-repair-dubai.html): Engine diagnostics, rebuilds, and repair.
- [Engine & Gearbox Overheating Repair](https://myfixhive.ae/engine-gearbox-overheating-repair-dubai.html): Diagnosis and repair of overheating engines and transmissions.
- [Gearbox / Transmission Repair](https://myfixhive.ae/gearbox-repair-dubai.html): Automatic and manual transmission repair and rebuilds.
- [Car AC Repair](https://myfixhive.ae/car-ac-repair-dubai.html): AC regassing, compressor, and system repair for UAE heat.
- [Brake Repair](https://myfixhive.ae/brake-repair-dubai.html): Brake pad, disc, and full brake system service.
- [Suspension Repair](https://myfixhive.ae/suspension-repair-dubai.html): Includes air suspension diagnostics and repair.
- [Oil Change](https://myfixhive.ae/oil-change-dubai.html): Scheduled oil and filter changes.
- [Electrical Repair](https://myfixhive.ae/electrical-repair-dubai.html): Vehicle electrical fault diagnosis and repair.
- [Car Diagnostics](https://myfixhive.ae/car-diagnostics-dubai.html): Dealer-level fault code diagnosis and ECU work.
- [Car Programming & Diagnosis](https://myfixhive.ae/diagnosis.html): Includes an AI-assisted car diagnosis tool.
- [Hybrid & EV Servicing](https://myfixhive.ae/hybrid-ev.html): Maintenance and repair for hybrid and electric vehicles.
- [Body & Exterior Work](https://myfixhive.ae/body.html): Bodywork, panel, and paint repair.
- [Car Detailing](https://myfixhive.ae/car-detailing-dubai.html): Detailing, ceramic coating, and PPF.
- [Tyres & Wheels](https://myfixhive.ae/tyres.html): Tyre replacement, alignment, and wheel service.
- [Pre-Purchase Inspection](https://myfixhive.ae/pre-purchase-inspection-dubai.html): Independent inspection before buying a used car.
- [Service Packages](https://myfixhive.ae/service-packages.html): Bundled maintenance packages.
- [Current Offers](https://myfixhive.ae/offers.html): Active promotions and discounts.
